name: test-harness
body: The shared test-helper layer: scratch-repo builders, the candidate-binary driver, and JSONL/fixture helpers used across tiers (today `src/testutil.rs` plus the per-module `mod tests` fixtures — 149 helper fns in `main.rs`, 105 in `plan_cmd.rs`, 104 in `layers.rs`, 75 in `splice.rs`). It must be reachable from both the sibling unit/int tests and the top-level e2e crates without duplication. The duplication is real and must converge: `with_cwd` is defined in four `mod tests` roots, `wt_commit` in three plus the shared `rust.apg.testutil.wt_commit`, and `wt_commit_paths` in two (see `requirements.note.dry-fixture-duplication`).
